scripts.build: npm run build -w @hackrice/contracts && npm run build -w @hackrice/api
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/contracts/test/*.test.mjs apps/api/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env apps/api/dist/cli.js migrate
scripts.data:import: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env apps/api/dist/cli.js import
scripts.jobs:run: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env apps/api/dist/cli.js jobs
